_readme: THE WALL FIT (2026-08-20, Palle: 'we need to find out how we can place things at the walls in the right way — does it fit, can we scale to fit, does it need a shelf, and some nice distance to the wall?'). One rule set consulted by BOTH sides: tools/spatial_negotiation.hang_on_wall (the plan) and commons/scenes/em/em_wall_fit.gd (the museum, and the reference wall). Edit in res://commons/scenes/wall_fit_reference.tscn — a nudge there IS the museum's new convention. Per-token overrides win over the defaults.
